== Course of events ==

After three sad days in which Dorothy received no word from Oz, on the fourth day Oz summons Dorothy and proposes crossing the desert by balloon, since he cannot make a cyclone. This follows the period during which Dorothy and Oz had spent days sewing green silk strips together and coating the balloon with glue for airtightness, and the clothes basket had been fastened to the balloon while Oz announced to the crowd that he was visiting a brother Wizard in the clouds.

The proposal arises directly from Oz's admission that a cyclone is beyond his power, making the balloon crossing of the desert the alternative means of travel he offers Dorothy. In the aftermath, Oz explains that the balloon's silk, coated in glue, will float on hot air rather than gas, and he lights a fire beneath it to fill it. He then declares that the Scarecrow will rule in his absence, and reveals that he plans to leave with Dorothy, admitting he is tired of being a humbug ruling in secret.
